## About
Al Kaplan Heating & Air Conditioning, Co. works out of Elmhurst Rd in Elk Grove Village, taking care of heating and air conditioning for homes and businesses in the area. We do sales, service and installation, and we also provide estimates on new installations.
We pay attention to details, because it's the little things that make the difference. We install premium quality and ENERGY STAR rated equipment, we make our own sheet metal, and we service all models.
Customers have rated us 5 on Google from 20 reviews. One longtime customer calls us a family owned business that really cares about its customers, and that is how we want every neighbor to feel.

## Services
- HVAC service and replacement: Our technicians are trained in HVAC service and replacements, and we service all models.
- Sales and installation: We handle sales and installation for homes and businesses.
- Estimates on new installations: Thinking about a new system? Ask us for an estimate.
- Our own sheet metal: We make our own sheet metal to fit just about every application.

## FAQ
Q: Do you help in an emergency?
A: Yes. One longtime customer writes that we have emergency service and respond quickly.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We provide heating and air conditioning service to Elk Grove Village and surrounding areas.

Q: Can you work on my brand of equipment?
A: Yes, we service all models.
